title.en: Follow the Pixel Grid to a Part

brief.zh: 维修员只给了起点和移动步数，用坐标找到目标。
brief.en: The repair technician gives you only the start and a pair of offsets. Find the target by its coordinates.

concept.zh: 横向位移加到 x，纵向位移加到 y。
concept.en: Add horizontal movement to x and vertical movement to y.

hints.zh: 向右两格意味着 x 加 2。向下两格意味着 y 加 2。
hints.en: Two tiles right adds 2 to x. Two tiles down adds 2 to y.

prompt.zh: 以 (2, 1) 为出发点，向右两格，再向下两格。读取最后到达的像素。
prompt.en: Start at (2, 1), move two tiles right and two tiles down, then read the destination pixel.
